primary_gt.mechanism_question: test whether dry daytime heat and atmospheric dryness dominate the event instead of humid heat, rainfall, or exposure-only context
primary_gt.decisive_evidence: The strongest evidence is the combination of hot daytime load and dry-air stress, with receptors treated as context rather than the trigger.
primary_gt.rejected_simplifications: Reject humid-heat dominance, rainfall moderation, and exposure-only explanations when meteorological forcing is stronger.
primary_gt.bounded_interpretation: The package can diagnose local dry-heat stress but cannot estimate actual fire spread, burned assets, or health outcomes.
